title: Pip and the Fireflies
text: Pip is a little dragon. He lives in a cozy cave. At night it gets dark. Pip does not like the dark. He steps out to the soft grass. The sky is full of stars. Then he sees small lights. Blink, blink! Giggle, giggle! It is kind fireflies. Hello, Pip! they sing. Fireflies are little beetles. Their glow is yellow and green. Pip smiles at his new pals. Please stay with me? he asks. We will! say the fireflies. Now Pip is not sad. He naps in soft glow.
